notes: Fairview is a highly built-out borough (2.06 sq miles). DCA calculated prospective need of 97 units; settled with NJBA at 95 (Borough proposed 95 based on data corrections). VLA resulted in RDP of 16 units from two approved residential projects at 429-439 Fairview Ave and 251-281 Broad Ave. Unmet need is 95 - 16 = 79 units. Borough satisfies unmet need through Borough-wide Mandatory Set-Aside Ordinance (20% for-sale, 15% rental, applies to 5+ unit MF projects) and existing AHO zones. Present Need (rehab) = 313 units addressed via BCHIP county program. Prior Round = 20 units; Third Round = 44 units; both addressed through earlier compliance mechanisms. Candidate snapshot had incorrect prospective_need (117) and rdp (0) — corrected per HEFSP: prospective need 95 (settled), RDP 16.
